About this notice

This notice explains how information is handled when you visit the music and visual portfolio of Artan Davoodi (legal name: Saeed Davoodi), operating from Croatia. For privacy enquiries, contact contact@artandavoodi.com.

Browser storage

If you allow preferences, local browser storage remembers your theme and whether the introduction has been shown. Your allow or decline choice is retained for up to 180 days to respect your decision. You can withdraw permission using Privacy preferences. Without permission, the theme can still be changed on the current page but is not saved between visits.

Gallery navigation

When you open a photograph, session storage temporarily remembers your gallery page, filters, scroll position and selected image so that returning restores your place. It is used for gallery navigation, not sent to the artist, and removed when restored or when the browser session ends.

Visiting this website

The hosting service processes connection information, including IP addresses, to deliver and protect the website. Following a streaming, social or other external link opens a separate service with its own privacy practices.

Hosting provider privacy information

Email enquiries

When you send an enquiry, your email address and message are used to respond to you. Email providers also process the message to deliver it. Please include only information relevant to your enquiry. To ask about a message you have sent or request its deletion, contact contact@artandavoodi.com.

Your choices and rights

You can withdraw optional storage permission at any time and clear this site's browser data. Contact contact@artandavoodi.com to ask about access, correction, deletion or other applicable data-protection rights. You may also contact Croatia's data-protection authority, AZOP.

Croatian data-protection authority

Artan Store

Artan Store has a separate privacy notice covering its account services and the information handled when you use the store. Please read that notice when visiting store.artandavoodi.com.
